load_yaml_from_file: load a YAML file from disk into a Python dictionary using YamlHandler load_from_path
dump_yaml_to_file: dump a Python dictionary to a YAML file on disk using YamlHandler dump_to_path
dump_yaml_to_string: serialize a Python object to a YAML string using YamlHandler dump_to_str
load_yaml_from_fileobj: parse YAML content from an open file object using YamlHandler load_from_fileobj
dump_yaml_to_fileobj: write a Python object as YAML to an open file object using YamlHandler dump_to_fileobj
